ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router using kNN over an exemplar index and LLM-judge writeback to direct student queries and university administrative paperwork to the correct department instantly.
ideas.title: Semantic Campus Route Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the proven architecture of darwin-router to solve a high-friction real-world bottleneck in university administration under the 'Build for Impact' theme.

ideas.pitch: A pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool for student-run university events that evaluates compliance, safety regulations, and resource allocation using Maestro BPMN and coded AI agents.
ideas.title: BPMN-Orchestrated Campus Event Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical sophistication that won UiPath AgentHack by bringing robust workflow automation and governance to complex human-in-the-loop processes.

ideas.pitch: An offline, privacy-first AI code review assistant running locally on Snapdragon NPUs to scan student repositories for security vulnerabilities without needing internet connectivity.
ideas.title: NPU-Accelerated Local Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning runner-up strategy of DevMesh by providing high-performance local AI tooling suited for resource-constrained offline demonstration environments.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running on lightweight Kubernetes to securely aggregate and query decentralized local clinic records for rural medical outreach.
ideas.title: Federated Clinical MCP Platform for Local Healthcare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the architecture of the MCP Clinical Platform winner to address a massive socio-economic impact area, directly fitting the 'Build for Impact' directive.

ideas.pitch: An auto-embedding and RAG toolkit optimized for MariaDB to instantly index, search, and summarize massive repositories of university lecture notes, research papers, and circulars.
ideas.title: TOON-Native Campus RAG Document Search
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-utility database integration pattern from seamless-rag, offering judges a blazing-fast, practical developer tool.
